description: This file defines the interface for managing network device traffic settings, including configuration parameters, default values, and related functions such as setting and getting harvesting status, reporting and polling periods, TTL, and handling IP table data.
external_methods: bool isvalueinarray_ndt(ULONG val, ULONG *arr, int size)

methods.name: SetNDTHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets whether harvesting of network devices is enabled or disabled.

methods.name: GetNDTHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for network devices.

methods.name: SetNDTReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period used in network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDTReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period for network device scans.

methods.name: SetNDTPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDTPollingPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current polling period.

methods.name: GetNDTReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default reporting period for network device scans.

methods.name: SetNDTReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period.

methods.name: GetNDTPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default polling period.

methods.name: SetNDTPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period.

methods.name: GetNDTOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default timeout for accelerated scans.

methods.name: ValidateNDTPeriod
methods.description: Validates that a given period value is within an acceptable range.

methods.name: SetNDTOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the timeout value for accelerated scans.

methods.name: GetNDTOverrideTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the current TTL interval for network device scans.

methods.name: ResetEBTables
methods.description: Resets the Ethernet bridge tables.

methods.name: GetIPTableData
methods.description: Retrieves current IP table data.

methods.name: isvalueinarray_ndt
methods.description: Checks if a value is present in an array.

methods.name: add_to_list_ndt
methods.description: Adds an IP table line to an internal list.

methods.name: print_list_ndt
methods.description: Prints the IP table list.

methods.name: delete_list_ndt
methods.description: Deletes the entire IP table list.

methods.name: delete_partial_list_ndt
methods.description: Deletes a part of the IP table list.
